messages:
emily: heads-up — a few customers reported 429s after the v2 rollout, seems related to routing/grace windows. console shows banner 'compat mode exceeded' for some tenants.
raj: looking... initial signals point to missing version header on some SDK clients. when header absent runtime defaults to affinity routing which pushes to v2, then quota attribution mismatches.
simon: can you paste an example request? I've seen this with `X-Redwood-Version` unset.
emily: sample from support:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer xxx
Content-Type: application/json
// no X-Redwood-Version header
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha",
  "input": "..."
}
```
raj: runtime code paths:
```
if (versionHeader) route = choose(versionHeader)
else route = chooseByTokenAffinity(token)
```
we may need a 'compat-prefer-v1' short-circuit for v1 clients during grace window.
maria: console UX question — when we surface 'compat mode exceeded' do we give actionable guidance? customers keep seeing red and opening tickets.
kevin: we have two options: 1) show per-tenant attribution (quota delta by inferred client) 2) add a 'soft-exempt' toggle in console for a time-limited grace that instructs routing to prefer v1.
simon: telemetry: we should emit a `compat_mismatch` tag on the request with values {inferred_version, routed_version, quota_owner}. will help count true incidents.
raj: agree. also propose a probe rollout for the new short-circuit: `runtime.flag.compat_shortcircuit = true` in us-west for 5%.
deploy-bot: deploy 1753219999: rollout started for runtime.flag.compat_shortcircuit -> 5% us-west
emily: action items: raj add probe + metric, simon add `compat_mismatch` field to logs, kevin wire console soft-exempt UX copy and telemetry surface; maria please triage urgent tickets and send customers the short-explanation.
maria: on it. rough ETA 2h for first replies. I'll paste a templated note.
kevin: mock for UX copy on console: "Temporary compatibility grace: prefer v1 routing for flagged tenants for X hours to reduce 429s. This does not bypass quota limits. Recommended when you see sudden v2 attribution spikes." thoughts?
emily: looks good. one more: let's ensure the console toggle shows how many requests would have been rerouted (estimate) — helps decision.
raj: I'll add an estimate signal: count where inferred_v1 && routed_v2 in last 10m.
simon: will add a Grafana panel and alert if estimate > 100/s for > 2m.
emily: thanks team. we'll reconvene after probe results. :thumbsup:
